methods.name: agents.list

methods.name: approval.pending

methods.name: approval.received

methods.name: approval.respond

methods.name: billing.auto_reload

methods.name: billing.charge
methods.summary: Start a one-off top-up charge (billing:manage, idempotent).

methods.name: billing.charge_status

methods.name: billing.state
methods.summary: Read-only billing view (no scope); the Nous free tier is answered locally without a portal call.

methods.name: billing.step_up

methods.name: browser.manage

methods.name: clarify.lock

methods.name: cli.exec

methods.name: clipboard.paste

methods.name: command.dispatch

methods.name: command.resolve
methods.summary: Canonical registry command for a name or alias.

methods.name: commands.catalog
methods.summary: Categorized slash metadata (registry, quick, plugin, skill) for completion menus.

methods.name: complete.path

methods.name: complete.slash

methods.name: config.get

methods.name: config.set

methods.name: config.show
methods.summary: Masked, display-ready config summary (model / agent / environment rows).

methods.name: connection.respond

methods.name: connectors.accounts

methods.name: connectors.accounts.remove

methods.name: connectors.accounts.rename

methods.name: connectors.catalog

methods.name: connectors.connect

methods.name: connectors.list

methods.name: connectors.operation.status

methods.name: connectors.operation.wake

methods.name: connectors.policy.get

methods.name: connectors.policy.set

methods.name: connectors.tools

methods.name: cron.manage

methods.name: delegation.pause

methods.name: delegation.status

methods.name: diagnostics.share_nous

methods.name: file.attach

methods.name: free_tier.ack_notice

methods.name: free_tier.challenge_result

methods.name: free_tier.claim_nudge

methods.name: free_tier.status

methods.name: i18n.catalog

methods.name: image.attach

methods.name: image.attach_bytes

methods.name: image.detach
methods.summary: Drop a queued image before the turn is sent.

methods.name: image.generate

methods.name: input.detect_drop

methods.name: insights.get
methods.summary: Session/message counts over the last ``days`` for the (optionally scoped) profile store.

methods.name: learning.delete
methods.summary: Archive a skill (restorable via curator) or remove a memory chunk.

methods.name: learning.detail

methods.name: learning.edit

methods.name: learning.frames

methods.name: llm.oneshot

methods.name: mcp.catalog

methods.summary: Add a server to the profile's config from a catalog preset and/or an explicit config.

methods.name: mcp.servers.list
methods.summary: Configured MCP servers for the (scoped) profile, secrets redacted to env-key names.

methods.name: mcp.servers.oauth.callback
methods.summary: Relay a client-captured redirect into a client_redirect_uri flow.

methods.name: mcp.servers.oauth.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a flow owned by the resolved profile, waking its callback worker.

methods.name: mcp.servers.oauth.poll
methods.summary: Poll a flow; approved persists tokens for the profile and returns the probed tools.

methods.name: mcp.servers.oauth.start
methods.summary: Begin a PKCE OAuth flow; the client opens auth_url and polls mcp.servers.oauth.poll.

methods.name: mcp.servers.remove

methods.name: mcp.servers.set_api_key
methods.summary: Store a credential in the profile's .env and reference it from the server config (header or env).

methods.name: mcp.servers.status

methods.name: mcp.servers.test
methods.summary: Connect, list tools, disconnect — an OAuth server with no token on disk is reported as not ok.

methods.name: message.react

methods.name: model.disconnect
methods.summary: Remove every credential (env keys and OAuth state) for a provider.

methods.name: model.options

methods.name: model.save_key
methods.summary: Save an API key for a provider and return its refreshed inventory row.

methods.name: paste.collapse
methods.summary: Spill a large paste to a file and hand back the inline placeholder.

methods.name: pdf.attach

methods.name: pet.cancel

methods.name: pet.cells

methods.name: pet.disable

methods.name: pet.export

methods.name: pet.gallery
methods.summary: Petdex gallery + local install state (installed-only offline); localOnly skips the remote manifest.

methods.name: pet.generate
methods.summary: Candidate base looks for a new pet (draft step); drafts also stream via pet.generate.progress.

methods.name: pet.generate.status
methods.summary: Whether pet generation is possible (a reference-capable image backend) and which providers.

methods.name: pet.hatch
methods.summary: Turn a base draft into a full spritesheet pet; progress streams via pet.hatch.progress.

methods.name: pet.info
methods.summary: Active pet for sprite renderers: spritesheet (base64) + frame geometry + state-row taxonomy.

methods.name: pet.info.meta

methods.name: pet.scale

methods.name: pet.select

methods.name: pet.thumb
methods.summary: Idle-frame PNG data URI for the picker (desktop CSP breaks CDN ).

methods.name: ping
methods.summary: Cheapest liveness probe; answered on the WS reader thread even while every agent is mid-turn.

methods.name: plugins.catalog.lookup
methods.summary: One curated plugin-catalog entry by name, from the backend's live catalog (cached, with the in-tree fallback and kill list); backs hermes://plugin/install?catalog= deep links.

methods.name: plugins.list

methods.name: plugins.manage
methods.summary: Plugins Hub backend: list installed plugins, toggle, git-install, re-pin a catalog install, or remove a user install.

methods.name: process.kill
methods.summary: Kill one background process the caller's session owns and return its output snapshot.

methods.name: process.list
methods.summary: Background processes owned by the caller's session (desktop status stack poll).

methods.name: process.stop
methods.summary: ``/stop``: on the shared owner, kill the background processes ``session_id`` owns (required); a standalone sidecar kills every process it holds. Answers the count killed.

methods.name: project.facts
methods.summary: Structured project facts for a cwd so UIs don't re-sniff the workspace.

methods.name: prompt.background

methods.name: prompt.btw

methods.name: prompt.submit
methods.summary: Send a user turn to a live session; busy sessions queue / steer / redirect instead of refusing.

methods.name: reload.env

methods.summary: Tear down and rediscover MCP servers for every live session (prompt cache is invalidated).

methods.name: rollback.diff
methods.summary: Diff between a checkpoint and the working tree, with an ANSI rendering sized to the TUI.

methods.name: rollback.list
methods.summary: Checkpoints for the session's cwd; ``enabled: false`` when checkpointing is off.

methods.name: rollback.restore
methods.summary: Restore the working tree (or one file) to a checkpoint by hash or 1-based index.

methods.name: session.activate
methods.summary: Attach the frontend to a live session without closing the previously focused one.

methods.name: session.active_list
methods.summary: Live sessions in this process, insertion order (not a DB browser).

methods.name: session.archive
methods.summary: Set/clear archived (soft-hide, messages kept) on a session + lineage; Desktop PATCH parity.

methods.name: session.branch
methods.summary: Fork a live session into a new stored child that shares the parent's history so far.

methods.name: session.branch_stored
methods.summary: Whole-session branch of a stored parent: the owning backend reads and copies the transcript, which never crosses the wire (a separate method so an older gateway fails loudly, not with an empty branch).

methods.name: session.branch_whole
methods.summary: session.branch of the whole history without echoing the copied transcript back.

methods.name: session.close
methods.summary: Tear down a live session (its stored row stays resumable).

methods.name: session.compress
methods.summary: Manual /compress of an idle session, optionally focused on a topic.

methods.name: session.context_breakdown
methods.summary: Cursor-style split of the context window by category.

methods.name: session.control
methods.summary: Run one allowlisted goal / loop / subgoal / heartbeat action and return the exact resulting snapshot.

methods.name: session.control.read
methods.summary: Stable, allowlisted snapshot of one live session's goal / loop / heartbeat state.

methods.name: session.create
methods.summary: Mint a live session (agent builds after the reply); a DB row appears on the first prompt unless seeded.

methods.name: session.cwd.set
methods.summary: Change a live, idle session's working directory.

methods.name: session.delete
methods.summary: Delete a stored session + transcripts; refused while it is live here.

methods.name: session.events.since
methods.summary: Replay events after a seq watermark on WS reconnect; truncated means refetch state.

methods.name: session.events.stats
methods.summary: Replay-buffer occupancy telemetry (ops/debug).

methods.name: session.history
methods.summary: The durable display transcript (ancestors included, row ids attached).

methods.name: session.interrupt
methods.summary: Stop the running turn (and streaming TTS); retires the crash-recovery marker.

methods.name: session.list
methods.summary: Human-facing stored sessions, most recent first (sub-agent / kanban sources denied).

methods.name: session.most_recent
methods.summary: Most recent human-facing session; errors fold into a null session_id.

methods.name: session.redirect
methods.summary: Redirect the active turn (queued for the next turn while the agent is still building).

methods.name: session.resume
methods.summary: Attach to a stored session: reuse it if live here, else lazy / deferred / cold / eager rebuild.

methods.name: session.save
methods.summary: Export the transcript to ~/.hermes/sessions/saved (classic /save).

methods.name: session.set_hidden
methods.summary: Set/clear hidden (out of the default list, still resumable by its owner) on a session + lineage.

methods.name: session.status
methods.summary: Rendered /status text for the session.

methods.name: session.steer
methods.summary: Inject text into the next tool result without interrupting the turn.

methods.name: session.title
methods.summary: Read or set a live session's title; a title set before the row exists is queued.

methods.name: session.undo
methods.summary: Drop the last user turn (and everything after it) from an idle session.

methods.name: session.usage
methods.summary: Token / context / cost counters for the session (+ Nous credit lines when available).

methods.name: session.workspace.move
methods.summary: Re-home a stored session's workspace; git identity is replaced and a live agent follows.

methods.name: setup.runtime_check
methods.summary: Strict provider check through the same runtime resolution the agent uses on session creation.

methods.name: setup.status
methods.summary: Loose provider check: is ANY provider auth state discoverable for the (launch or named) profile.

methods.name: shared_metrics.set

methods.name: shared_metrics.startup_latency
methods.summary: Record one client launch-to-ready latency (fire-and-forget; a no-op unless shared metrics are on).

methods.name: shared_metrics.status
methods.summary: Pure read of the focused profile's shared-metrics opt-ins (collection, upload, answered).

methods.name: shell.exec
methods.summary: Run a safe (non-dangerous) shell command captured for ``!cmd`` / inline substitution.

methods.name: skills.manage

methods.name: skills.reload
methods.summary: Re-scan skill dirs; the pre-rendered ``output`` is what /reload-skills prints.

methods.name: slash.exec
methods.summary: Execute a slash command against the session's slash worker (or a live/plugin shortcut).

methods.name: spawn_tree.list
methods.summary: Saved spawn-tree snapshots, newest first.

methods.name: spawn_tree.load
methods.summary: Read one saved spawn-tree snapshot (path must be under the spawn-trees root).

methods.name: spawn_tree.save
methods.summary: Persist a finished delegation tree snapshot under the session's spawn-trees dir.

methods.name: subagent.interrupt
methods.summary: Hard-interrupt one owned child; ``found`` is false when it already finished.

methods.name: subagent.list
methods.summary: Live children owned by this session (other sessions' children never leak).

methods.name: subagent.steer
methods.summary: Queue steering text into a live delegated child owned by this session.

methods.name: subagent.tail
methods.summary: Last 16KB of an owned child's live transcript.

methods.name: subscription.change
methods.summary: Schedule a downgrade / same-price change or a period-end cancellation.

methods.name: subscription.preview
methods.summary: Chargeless quote of what a plan change would do (billing:manage).

methods.name: subscription.resume
methods.summary: Clear a scheduled downgrade / cancellation (re-enables recurring spend).

methods.name: subscription.state
methods.summary: Current plan, tier catalog and usage for the picker; fail-open when logged out.

methods.name: subscription.upgrade
methods.summary: Prorate, charge and flip the plan (billing:manage, idempotent).

methods.name: system.battery
methods.summary: Host battery for the status bar; always resolves, ``available: false`` when unreadable.

methods.name: terminal.resize
methods.summary: Record the client's column width for server-side rendering.

methods.name: tools.configure
methods.summary: Persist a toolset / MCP enable-disable change and rebuild the session agent so it takes effect now.

methods.name: tools.list
methods.summary: Every toolset with its resolved tool names, flagged against the session's (or config's) enabled set.

methods.name: tools.show
methods.summary: The /tools listing grouped by toolset, including tools deferred behind the tool_search bridge.

methods.name: toolsets.list
methods.summary: Toolset summaries (no tool names) for the desktop Toolsets tab.

methods.name: usage.bars
methods.summary: Two-bar dollar usage view shared by /usage, /topup and /subscription; fail-open to unavailable.

methods.name: vault.add
methods.summary: Add a login / payment / address item to the local vault.

methods.name: vault.list
methods.summary: Metadata-only listing across the local vault and every unlocked password manager.

methods.name: vault.lock
methods.summary: Forget a manager's session token (every manager when no name is given).

methods.name: vault.remove
methods.summary: Remove a local vault item by id.

methods.name: vault.source.set
methods.summary: Enable or disable an external password manager (disabling also locks it).

methods.name: vault.sources
methods.summary: Status of every login source (local vault + detected password managers).

methods.name: vault.unlock
methods.summary: Unlock a password manager for this session with its master password.

methods.name: verification.status
methods.summary: Best known verification evidence for a cwd/session; read-only, never runs checks.

methods.name: voice.record
methods.summary: VAD-bounded push-to-talk; the transcript arrives as a voice.transcript event.

methods.name: voice.toggle
methods.summary: /voice parity: report, flip voice mode on/off, or toggle speech output.

methods.name: voice.tts
methods.summary: Speak text through the backend TTS engine (barge-in aware).

methods.name: wake.feed
methods.summary: Push client-captured PCM into the armed detector (mic-less remote backends).

methods.name: wake.pause
methods.summary: Release the mic (e.g. while the desktop's browser captures audio).

methods.name: wake.resume
methods.summary: Reclaim the mic after a pause; no-op if the listener isn't armed.

methods.name: wake.start
methods.summary: Arm the wake-word listener for the calling surface; refusals explain why.

methods.name: wake.status
methods.summary: Everything a client needs to draw the wake-word state and decide whether to (re)arm.

methods.name: wake.stop
methods.summary: Stop this surface's listener; persist also writes wake_word.enabled: false.

ActiveSubagent.description:
One live child from ``tools/delegate_tool_registry.py::list_active_subagents`` (the record
is extended by the child runner — ``missed_steer`` etc. — so it stays open).
ActiveSubagent.title: ActiveSubagent

ApprovalCancelledPayload.description:
``session_lifecycle._announce_cancelled_gateway_approvals`` (broadcast).

One frame for every pending approval dropped by an interrupt / reap / teardown (#106678) — the
deny-resolve is silent without it, so a reconnecting client's prompt looks lost rather than cancelled.
``cancelled_count`` is the number of dropped entries; ``request_ids`` omits empty/missing ids, so the
two can disagree when an entry has no request_id.
ApprovalCancelledPayload.title: ApprovalCancelledPayload

ApprovalRespondParams.description:
``choice`` is one of the offered ``approval`` choices (once / session / always / deny); ``all``
resolves every pending approval, ``request_id`` a specific one, neither the oldest.
ApprovalRespondParams.title: ApprovalRespondParams

AttachedImageResult.description: ``methods_prompt.py::_attached_image_result``: the image is queued for the next turn.
AttachedImageResult.title: AttachedImageResult

AutoContinue.description: A crash-interrupted turn was scheduled to continue right after this resume.
AutoContinue.title: AutoContinue

BillingChargeResult.description: ``202 {chargeId}`` — money is not confirmed yet; poll ``billing.charge_status``.
BillingChargeResult.title: BillingChargeResult

BillingChargeStatusResult.description: Single status read (pending | settled | failed); the caller drives the poll cadence.
BillingChargeStatusResult.title: BillingChargeStatusResult

BillingMutationResult.description: A write with no success payload beyond ``ok``.
BillingMutationResult.title: BillingMutationResult

BillingPaymentMethod.description:
``_serialize_payment_method``: each kind emits only its own fields (a ``card`` never carries
``email``; ``unknown`` carries what the server called it in ``raw_kind``).
BillingPaymentMethod.title: BillingPaymentMethod

BillingPendingChangeResult.description: ``_billing_pending_change``: ``message`` + the raw NAS body in ``payload`` on success.
BillingPendingChangeResult.title: BillingPendingChangeResult

BillingStateResult.description:
``_serialize_billing_state`` (money as strings); the ``except`` fallback emits only
``ok / logged_in / free_tier_account / error``, so everything else is optional.
BillingStateResult.title: BillingStateResult

BillingStepUpResult.description: ``granted`` false when the server downscopes (also on every error envelope).
BillingStepUpResult.title: BillingStepUpResult

CatalogAppState.description: The desktop app a catalog plugin drives, from its ``hermes_platform`` declaration.
CatalogAppState.title: CatalogAppState

CatalogApproved.description:
The non-secret Advanced choices the user approved on a catalog row; a Try again after the
operation settled repeats them.
CatalogApproved.title: CatalogApproved

CatalogPluginPresence.description:
A named catalog plugin this OS runs. ``state`` is the pinned ``plugin.json`` app declaration judged
on this host; ``sentence`` names what is missing (empty when present or unknown); ``disclosure`` is the
catalog description's ``Disclosure:`` sentence (empty when it has none).
CatalogPluginPresence.title: CatalogPluginPresence

CatalogScan.description: The catalog's security scan of the pinned commit; read-only on the card.
CatalogScan.title: CatalogScan

CatalogServerError.description: An MCP server an installed plugin brought that did not connect, with the raw reason.
CatalogServerError.title: CatalogServerError

ChangeSignalPayload.description: ``change_watcher._CHANGE_WATCHES`` payload fn — ``{}`` for every watch except pet.changed.
ChangeSignalPayload.title: ChangeSignalPayload

ClarifyLockResult.description:
``remaining`` lists the qids still unanswered; the lock that empties it resolves the request.
``expired``: the wait already ended (timeout / cancel) — not an error.
ClarifyLockResult.title: ClarifyLockResult

ClarifyRequestParams.description: ``answers`` rides only on a reconnect replay (locks the server already accepted; null = skipped).
ClarifyRequestParams.title: ClarifyRequestParams

ClarifyResult.description:
``{answers}`` for the whole set (early locks go through the ``clarify.lock`` RPC); a response
without ``answers`` is cancel-all. ``outcome`` (optional): how the viewer's own panel ended, as
main's classic CLI reports it (``timed_out`` keeps the answers locked before its deadline).
ClarifyResult.title: ClarifyResult

CommandDispatchResult.description:
One structured directive: ``exec``/``plugin`` carry ``output``; ``alias`` a ``target``;
``send``/``prefill``/``skill`` a ``message`` (UIs render ``display``, never ``message``).
CommandDispatchResult.title: CommandDispatchResult

CompletePathParams.description:
``word`` is the token under the cursor (``@`` prefix = context reference); ``cwd`` /
``session_id`` pick the directory the listing resolves against.
CompletePathParams.title: CompletePathParams

CompleteSlashParams.description:
``session_id`` binds skill completions to that session's profile and workspace (project skills);
``profile`` scopes a session-less request (a new-chat draft).
CompleteSlashParams.title: CompleteSlashParams

CompleteSlashResult.description: ``replace_from`` is the column the accepted item replaces from.
CompleteSlashResult.title: CompleteSlashResult

CompletionItem.description: One popover row; ``kind`` rides only on slash completions (command vs skill).
CompletionItem.title: CompletionItem

ConfigGetParams.description:
``key`` selects one getter from ``_CONFIG_GETTERS``; ``cwd`` feeds the ``project`` getter,
``session_id`` lets ``reasoning`` / ``fast`` answer with the session's live pin.
ConfigGetParams.title: ConfigGetParams

ConfigGetResult.description:
Union of every getter's payload: ``value`` for the simple words, ``config`` for ``full``,
``mtime`` / ``mcp_rev`` for the poller, ``model`` / ``provider`` / ``providers`` for ``provider``,
``home`` / ``display`` for ``profile``, ``cwd`` / ``branch`` for ``project``, ``prompt``.
ConfigGetResult.title: ConfigGetResult

ConfigSetParams.title: ConfigSetParams

ConfigSetResult.description:
``{key, value}`` plus the setter's extras: model switches add ``warning`` /
``confirm_required`` / ``confirm_message`` / ``scope`` / ``deferred``; ``focus`` adds
``tool_progress``; ``cwd`` adds ``cwd`` / ``branch``; ``personality`` adds ``history_reset`` /
``info``; ``yolo`` reports its ``scope``. ``value`` is a bool only for the display toggles.
ConfigSetResult.title: ConfigSetResult

ConnectionAnswer.description:
The card's answer: per-target outcomes and an optional Continue
(``settled_by: "continue"``). Settlement is derived from target states afterwards.
ConnectionAnswer.title: ConnectionAnswer

ConnectionAnswerStatus.description: What the card says about one row: ``tools/connectors/mcp.py::apply_answer``.
ConnectionAnswerStatus.title: ConnectionAnswerStatus

ConnectionAnswerTarget.description:
One row's answer from the card. ``env`` carries the credential values an install asked for
through ``required_env``.
ConnectionAnswerTarget.title: ConnectionAnswerTarget

ConnectionDisplay.description: ``manage_connections`` action ``display``: the directory card, with these slugs pinned as Suggested.
ConnectionDisplay.title: ConnectionDisplay

ConnectionOperationTarget.description:
``Target.snapshot``: the link minted up front rides here, never in the model result. ``extra``
keys a leg records (``tools``, ``hint``) are typed here as they appear.
ConnectionOperationTarget.title: ConnectionOperationTarget

ConnectionRequestPayload.description:
``ConnectionOperation.request_payload``: opens the card; also the ``pending_connection`` resume
snapshot so a client that missed the event restores the card with the server's deadline.
ConnectionRequestPayload.title: ConnectionRequestPayload

ConnectionTargetEnvField.description:
One credential an MCP install still needs; the card renders a field per entry and sends the
values back with the approval.
ConnectionTargetEnvField.title: ConnectionTargetEnvField

ConnectionUpdatePayload.description:
``methods_connectors._connection_update``: one target transition (``target``/``from``/``to``/
``actor``) or the settlement (none of those), with the full snapshot.
ConnectionUpdatePayload.title: ConnectionUpdatePayload

ConnectorsConnectResult.description: ``methods_connectors._reissue`` / ``managed._off_desktop_result``: the operation the connect opened; ``status``/``note`` ride along from the tool result.
ConnectorsConnectResult.title: ConnectorsConnectResult

CronManageResult.description:
Pass-through of ``tools/cronjob_tools.py::cronjob`` JSON: ``list`` → ``jobs``/``count``
(+ ``scoped`` when profile-scoped); ``add`` → the created job's summary + ``job``; ``remove`` →
``removed_job``; ``pause``/``resume`` → ``job``. A tool-level failure lands in ``error``.
CronManageResult.title: CronManageResult

DiagnosticsShareNousResult.description: Structured envelope: ``ok=False`` + ``error`` renders inline instead of failing the RPC.
DiagnosticsShareNousResult.title: DiagnosticsShareNousResult

ErrorSurface.description:
``agent/error_surface.py::_surface`` — advisory {layer, code, retryable} (+ identity, + auth hint,
+ ``resets_at`` epoch seconds when the provider named when its limit lifts).
ErrorSurface.title: ErrorSurface

FailedDelegation.description: ``async_delegation.failed_delegations_for_session`` row: one failed task of an async delegation.
FailedDelegation.title: FailedDelegation

FileAttachParams.description:
``path`` when the file is gateway-visible, else ``data_url`` carries the bytes; ``name`` labels
an uploaded file.
FileAttachParams.title: FileAttachParams

FreeTierChallengePayload.description:
``hermes_cli/anon_challenge.py::BrowserChallenge.as_payload``: the ``free_tier.challenge``
event, and ``free_tier.status``'s ``challenge`` field for a client that connected after it.
FreeTierChallengePayload.title: FreeTierChallengePayload

FreeTierStatusResult.description:
``available`` = an identity exists AND the tier is on; whether inference runs on it is
``setup.runtime_check.free_tier_route``'s question.
FreeTierStatusResult.title: FreeTierStatusResult

I18nCatalogResult.description:
``messages`` is ONLY the pack + user-overlay layer for that surface (flat dotted keys); the
client merges it over its bundled ``en``/``<lang>``. ``lang`` is the canonical id the request
resolved to (``pt-BR`` → ``pt-br``; an unknown id resolves to ``en`` with an empty layer).

ImageAttachBytesParams.description:
``content_base64`` (or the ``data`` alias) carries the bytes; ``filename`` / ``ext`` only hint
the extension — magic bytes decide.
ImageAttachBytesParams.title: ImageAttachBytesParams

ImageGenerateResult.description:
``probe`` answers ``{available}`` alone; ``image_data`` (data URL) is omitted when the
download failed or exceeded ``max_bytes`` so callers fall back to ``image``.
ImageGenerateResult.title: ImageGenerateResult

InflightTurn.description:
``session_auto_continue._inflight_snapshot``: the live (or retained failed) turn a reconnecting
client rebuilds its bubbles from.
InflightTurn.title: InflightTurn

InputDetectDropResult.description:
``matched: false`` alone when the text is not a drop; an image drop is queued immediately
(``is_image`` + ``count``), a file drop only yields the ``text`` to insert.
InputDetectDropResult.title: InputDetectDropResult

InstallPhase.description: The slow steps of an install, as ids; the desktop catalog card words them in its own language.
InstallPhase.title: InstallPhase

LanguageOption.description:
``agent.i18n_languages.language_options`` row. ``source`` is ``bundled``, ``overlay`` or
``plugin:<name>`` — the highest layer that supplies the language.
LanguageOption.title: LanguageOption

LearningFrame.description:
``agent.learning_graph_render.render_graph`` projection; ``grid`` rows are lists of
``[text, styleKey, alpha?, hexOverride?]`` runs.
LearningFrame.title: LearningFrame

LlmOneshotParams.description: Needs a ``template`` or ``instructions`` / ``input``; a live ``session_id`` lends its model.
LlmOneshotParams.title: LlmOneshotParams

LoopSnapshot.description: ``_safe_loop_snapshot`` — persisted LoopState fields, never its route.
LoopSnapshot.title: LoopSnapshot

McpOauthFlowParams.description: ``session_id`` is the OAuth flow id returned by ``oauth.start`` (not a gateway session).
McpOauthFlowParams.title: McpOauthFlowParams

McpOauthStartParams.description:
With ``client_redirect_uri`` the CLIENT hosts the loopback and relays the code via
``mcp.servers.oauth.callback``.
McpOauthStartParams.title: McpOauthStartParams

McpServerSummary.description: ``tui_runtime/mcp_rpc_helpers.summarize_server`` — a server's config without secret values.
McpServerSummary.title: McpServerSummary

McpServersAddParams.description:
``preset`` (catalog id) and/or ``config`` (url/command/args/env/headers/auth/tools); a
``bearer_token`` is written to the profile's .env, only the header template persists.
McpServersAddParams.title: McpServersAddParams

McpServersTestResult.description: ``ok: false`` carries ``error``; ``prompts`` / ``resources`` are only counted on success.
McpServersTestResult.title: McpServersTestResult

MessageDeltaPayload.description:
``message.delta``. A session-authority local-viewer turn also publishes ``text: null``: the
reply segment boundary (the agent's ``stream_delta_callback(None)``, before tool lines) that
closes the classic CLI's reply box. Every other viewer ignores an empty chunk.
MessageDeltaPayload.title: MessageDeltaPayload

MessageReactParams.description:
``row_id`` is ``messages.id``; a not-yet-persisted live message names ``newest_role`` instead.
``emoji`` null clears; the same emoji again retracts.
MessageReactParams.title: MessageReactParams

MessageReaction.description:
One persisted reaction row (``hermes_state.messages.set_message_reaction``); ``seen`` is
stamped once announced.
MessageReaction.title: MessageReaction

MessageStartPayload.description:
``message.start``. Empty from the TUI gateway's emitters and for an ordinary admission;
``gateway/session_authority._stamp_claim`` adds an automation admission's async-result card
(``session_automation.admission_display``: a background-process completion) and its model
text, so a viewer that did not submit the turn paints the same header the submitter would.
MessageStartPayload.title: MessageStartPayload

ModelOptionProvider.description:
One ``hermes_cli/inventory.py::build_models_payload`` provider row (the union of every field
the builder sets; ``pricing_pending`` / ``free_tier_pending`` mark the cached-only path).
ModelOptionProvider.title: ModelOptionProvider

ModelPricing.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_pricing`` — formatted $/Mtok strings (``""`` unknown,
``"free"``); the sale fields are Nous Portal-only.
ModelPricing.title: ModelPricing

NotificationShowPayload.description:
``agent/credits_tracker.py::AgentNotice`` via notice_callback, and ``server._await_agent_ready``'s
slow-build notice. ``level``: info | warn | error | success; ``kind``: sticky | ttl | agent.
NotificationShowPayload.title: NotificationShowPayload

OnboardingCatalogPlugin.description:
A catalog plugin curated for the onboarding card (``onboarding: true``) that this OS runs.
``app_state`` is the pinned ``plugin.json`` declaration judged on this host; ``sentence`` names what
is missing (empty when present or unknown).
OnboardingCatalogPlugin.title: OnboardingCatalogPlugin

OpenRequestEntry.description:
One unanswered server→client request (``server_requests.Request.snapshot``); the reconnecting
client re-delivers it to its request handlers.
OpenRequestEntry.title: OpenRequestEntry

PdfAttachParams.description:
Host ``path`` or base64 ``content_base64`` / ``data``; ``first_page`` / ``last_page`` bound the
render (per-call page cap enforced server-side).
PdfAttachParams.title: PdfAttachParams

PendingApproval.description:
One unresolved ``tools/approval.py`` gateway queue entry as ``server._approval_request_payload``
renders it (command redacted; ``choices`` precomputed). The key set is owned by the approval tool.
PendingApproval.title: PendingApproval

PersistedTurn.description:
Committed SQLite row addresses for the agent's current-turn suffix. Missing ids are
unproven, never negative acknowledgements. ``complete`` permits retiring the whole local
turn only when the original turn boundary, every row and final body are still accounted
for; compaction, redirects and partial writes conservatively leave it false. Row ids are
scoped to the owning profile's store, as in ``SessionMessage.row_id``.
PersistedTurn.title: PersistedTurn

PetCellsParams.description: ``graphics`` opts into the kitty payload when the TTY speaks it; ``cols`` overrides the width.
PetCellsParams.title: PetCellsParams

PetCellsResult.description:
Unicode: ``frames`` is frame → row → cell ``[tr,tg,tb,ta, br,bg,bb,ba]``; kitty (``graphics``
set): ``frames`` are transmit escapes and ``placeholder`` the text grid.
PetCellsResult.title: PetCellsResult

PetGenerateParams.description: ``prompt`` or a ``referenceImage`` data URL is required (the handler answers 4004 without one).
PetGenerateParams.title: PetGenerateParams

PetGenerateProgressPayload.description: ``methods_session`` pet.generate: token-only init frame, then one per draft.
PetGenerateProgressPayload.title: PetGenerateProgressPayload

PetHatchProgressPayload.description: ``methods_session`` pet.hatch ``_on_progress``: ``{event, detail}`` or the parsed row form.
PetHatchProgressPayload.title: PetHatchProgressPayload

PetHatchResult.description: The hatched pet is installed but NOT active (``pet.select`` adopts, ``pet.remove`` discards).
PetHatchResult.title: PetHatchResult

PetInfoParams.description: ``knownRevision``: the spritesheet revision the caller already holds (send-once bytes).
PetInfoParams.title: PetInfoParams

PetInfoResult.description:
``server._pet_sprite_payload`` behind ``enabled``; every sprite field is absent when the pet
display is off, ``spritesheetBase64`` is elided when ``spritesheetUnchanged``.
PetInfoResult.title: PetInfoResult

PetThumbParams.description: ``url``: spritesheet source for a not-yet-installed pet.
PetThumbParams.title: PetThumbParams

PluginActivation.description:
What a plugin loaded mid-run does NOW vs later (``hermes_cli.plugins_activation``). ``activated_now``
kinds (``{kind: [names]}``): ``commands`` (native slash names), ``locales`` (``<lang>.<surface>``
language-pack layers), and ``hooks``. ``live_now``: the plugin's MCP servers (connected, with their tools, or the
error) and skills, usable in every open chat of the profile from its next turn — the chats also get a
note listing them. ``deferred`` kinds: ``tools`` (Python tool names) and ``prompt`` (section ids)
apply from the next session.
PluginActivation.title: PluginActivation

PluginCatalogLookupEntry.description: The fields an install needs: the same ones the embedded catalog picker posts on a pick.
PluginCatalogLookupEntry.title: PluginCatalogLookupEntry

PluginCatalogLookupResult.description:
``found`` carries ``entry``. ``unknown`` covers a name the catalog doesn't list and one it removed;
``unavailable`` means neither the live catalog nor the in-tree fallback could be read.
PluginCatalogLookupResult.title: PluginCatalogLookupResult

PluginLiveServer.description: One plugin MCP server connected at activation: its callable tool names, or the reason it did not connect.
PluginLiveServer.title: PluginLiveServer

PluginLiveSkill.description: One plugin skill usable now through ``skill_view`` (qualified ``<plugin>:<skill>``).
PluginLiveSkill.title: PluginLiveSkill

PluginSettingField.description:
One ``config_schema`` key of a plugin manifest, rendered by the Plugins hub
(``hermes_cli.plugins_settings.plugin_settings_fields``). ``secret`` fields carry no value: ``env``
names the ``.env`` variable and ``has_value`` whether it is set.
PluginSettingField.title: PluginSettingField

PluginsManageParams.title: PluginsManageParams

PluginsManageResult.description:
``list`` → ``plugins`` + counts; ``toggle`` → ``ok``/``unchanged``/``restart_required``/``name``
(the canonical key written)/``plugin``; ``install`` → ``hermes_cli.plugins_cmd.dashboard_install_plugin``'s
ok payload; ``toggle``/``install``/``update`` that loaded a plugin also carry ``activation`` —
the honest split of native capabilities live now versus pinned Python tools/prompts deferred
to the next session; ``update`` → ``ok``/``unchanged``/``sha``, or ``ok=false`` + ``consent_required`` with the
``delta`` (``{surface: [added...]}``) / ``delta_lines`` a widened pin adds — nothing changed until the
client retries with ``accept_capabilities``; ``remove`` → ``ok``/``name`` plus
``cleared_memory_provider`` when the removed plugin was the live ``memory.provider``.
PluginsManageResult.title: PluginsManageResult

ProcessKillResult.description: ``tools/process_registry.py::kill_process`` snapshot; ``error`` rides on the failure statuses.
ProcessKillResult.title: ProcessKillResult

ProfileParams.description: Any method the desktop may route to a named profile (``requestGatewayForProfile`` adds ``profile``).
ProfileParams.title: ProfileParams

ProjectFactsResult.description: ``facts`` null outside a workspace (or when detection failed).
ProjectFactsResult.title: ProjectFactsResult

PromptSubmitParams.description:
``text`` is normally a string; the relay / hosted paths may hand a structured (parts list)
payload, and the busy path renders it. Truncation (rewind / edit / regenerate) needs explicit
consent: ``confirm_truncate`` plus one durable target (``truncate_before_row_id`` preferred,
``truncate_before_message_id``, or the legacy ``truncate_before_user_ordinal``).
PromptSubmitParams.title: PromptSubmitParams

PromptSubmitResult.description:
``status`` is absent only on the typed-stop-phrase reply (``voice_stopped``). After a
truncation the survivor row ids let the client rebind its cached ``rowId``s (``None`` map
entries: drop the cached id). ``turn_isolation`` marks a compute-host dispatch.
PromptSubmitResult.title: PromptSubmitResult

ProviderLimit.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_limits`` — ``account``: the whole login is rate-limited until
``resets_at`` (ISO, absent when unknown); ``models``: only these models are, each until its time.
ProviderLimit.title: ProviderLimit

ProviderUsage.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_usage`` — the provider's subscription usage, from cache.

Multi-entry credential pools carry ``accounts`` (one row per account; the legacy ``windows``
stays EMPTY there — a provider-wide percentage across different logins would be fabricated).
Single-account providers keep the legacy ``windows`` gauge.
ProviderUsage.title: ProviderUsage

ProviderUsageAccount.description:
One account of a provider's credential pool (``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_pool_usage_accounts``).
``id`` is a stable non-secret account identity (never a key or URL); ``label`` may be empty (UI
falls back to a localized "Account N"). ``windows`` is empty while the account's usage is not
yet known — state carries the meaning, never a fabricated gauge.

``state``: ``ready`` — live quota below the cap (numeric windows present); ``limited`` — a live
credential-wide cooldown or exhausted account-scoped quota windows; ``unknown`` — no live
numeric windows (failed/empty fetch, stale snapshot, provider without a usage API);
``unavailable`` — DEAD auth row (kept visible, never a quota row).

``resets_at``: for a limited account, the LATEST of its exhausted account-scoped windows (or a
live cooldown when later); ``None`` when unknown (the frontend renders its own advisory, e.g.
the earliest limited sibling).
ProviderUsageAccount.title: ProviderUsageAccount

ProviderUsageWindow.description:
One subscription usage window (``agent/account_usage.py::AccountUsageWindow``): e.g. the 5-hour
session or the weekly cap, with how much of it is spent and when it rolls over (ISO).

``scope``: ``account`` — exhausting the window exhausts the whole login (Codex session/weekly,
so a limited account's resets_at must wait for it); ``model`` — the window caps only one model
family (Anthropic Opus/Sonnet weekly) and can never imply the account itself is out of quota.
ProviderUsageWindow.title: ProviderUsageWindow

ReloadEnvParams.description: The shared owner serves ``/reload`` for one session the caller controls (``session_id``).
ReloadEnvParams.title: ReloadEnvParams

ReloadMcpParams.description:
Without ``confirm`` the handler may answer ``confirm_required`` (per ``approvals.mcp_reload_confirm``);
``always`` persists the opt-out; ``rev`` is the config revision the caller wants loaded (coalescing).
ReloadMcpParams.title: ReloadMcpParams

RollbackRestoreResult.description:
``tools/checkpoint_manager.py::restore`` outcome; ``history_removed`` is added for a full
(non-file) restore that also rewound the live transcript.
RollbackRestoreResult.title: RollbackRestoreResult

RuntimeReadyPayload.description: The private stdio child's first frame.
RuntimeReadyPayload.title: RuntimeReadyPayload

SeedMessage.description:
One create-time transcript row (``session_history._coerce_seed_history``); ``text`` is the
legacy alias of ``content``; only ``display_kind: "hidden"`` is accepted from the wire. Clients
forward stored rows verbatim (``_row_id``, ``timestamp``, …) and the coercer drops what it does
not use, so the row stays open.
SeedMessage.title: SeedMessage

SessionArchiveParams.description: ``session_id`` (or its ``session_key`` alias) is a live runtime id first, else a stored id / key / title.
SessionArchiveParams.title: SessionArchiveParams

SessionCompressResult.description:
In-process: the before/after summary + replacement transcript. Compute host: its result passes
through (hence open) with ``turn_isolation``; a lock held elsewhere answers ``compressed: false``.
SessionCompressResult.title: SessionCompressResult

SessionContextBreakdownResult.description:
``agent.context_breakdown.compute_session_context_breakdown`` (empty categories before the agent builds)
plus the per-file context manifest (empty until the agent exists).
SessionContextBreakdownResult.title: SessionContextBreakdownResult

SessionControlDispatch.description: ``_dispatch_envelope`` — the command result's user-visible envelope, every key always present.
SessionControlDispatch.title: SessionControlDispatch

SessionControlParams.description:
``action`` is validated by the handler (unknown / gate actions answer ``4004``), so it stays a
string on the wire; ``SessionControlAction`` lists the accepted set.
SessionControlParams.title: SessionControlParams

SessionControlSnapshot.description:
``_snapshot_control`` — ``revision`` is a hash of the visible state (``""`` when empty);
``updated_at`` is the newest persisted timestamp (``0`` when none).
SessionControlSnapshot.title: SessionControlSnapshot

SessionCwdSetResult.description: The refreshed ``session.info`` view (full agent view, or the lazy shape).
SessionCwdSetResult.title: SessionCwdSetResult

SessionListRow.description:
``methods_session._session_row_summary``; ``resolved_id`` only on a title lookup that followed a
compression lineage to its tip.
SessionListRow.title: SessionListRow

SessionLiveInfo.description:
``tui_runtime/server.py::_session_info`` — the ``session.info`` event and the ``info`` field of
``session.create`` / ``session.resume`` / ``session.activate`` results.
SessionLiveInfo.title: SessionLiveInfo

SessionParams.description: Any method addressed at one live session.
SessionParams.title: SessionParams

SessionResumeParams.description: ``session_id`` is the STORED id (or an exact title); the reply's ``session_id`` is the runtime id.
SessionResumeParams.title: SessionResumeParams

SessionSaveResult.description: Under turn isolation the compute host's result passes through verbatim.
SessionSaveResult.title: SessionSaveResult

SessionSetHiddenParams.description: ``session_id`` is a live runtime id first, else a stored id / key / title.
SessionSetHiddenParams.title: SessionSetHiddenParams

SessionUsagePayload.description:
``server._start_usage_ticker`` (``usage``), or a canonical local viewer's session-cumulative
counters (``gateway/session_usage.py::usage_stats``, the ``session.stats`` dict) at the top level:
published after every API call and at turn end, what main's classic CLI read off its agent.
SessionUsagePayload.title: SessionUsagePayload

SetupRuntimeCheckResult.description:
``ok=False`` + ``error`` when the resolved model can't be served; ``free_tier_route`` says the
selected route is the welcome host.
SetupRuntimeCheckResult.title: SetupRuntimeCheckResult

SetupStatusResult.description:
``provider_configured`` is the loose answer; the boot record's fields (``ready``,
``free_tier_account``, ``free_tier_route``, ``other_providers``, ``inference_provider``) ride along
on the launch profile. An unknown ``profile`` answers ``ok=False`` + ``error``.
SetupStatusResult.title: SetupStatusResult

SharedMetricsConsentResult.description:
The focused profile's ``telemetry.shared_metrics`` opt-ins. ``send`` is never true while
``enabled`` is false; ``decided`` = either key is written in config.yaml (the shipped defaults
are not an answer) and it is not a ``reask``: an "off" from before the type-ahead fix, offered
once more with the reason.
SharedMetricsConsentResult.title: SharedMetricsConsentResult

SharedMetricsSetParams.description: ``send`` is ignored unless ``enabled``; ``first_run`` marks the Desktop first-run answer.
SharedMetricsSetParams.title: SharedMetricsSetParams

SharedMetricsSlashCommandParams.description:
``command`` is the raw typed name (no leading ``/``, no args); the backend canonicalizes it
against the published registry. ``session_id`` scopes the count to that session's profile.
SharedMetricsSlashCommandParams.title: SharedMetricsSlashCommandParams

SharedMetricsStartupLatencyParams.description:
``elapsed_ms`` = the client's own launch (TUI process start / Desktop app start) to ready
(TUI gateway ready / Desktop backend attached), measured once per launch by the client. The
client names its surface because a Desktop may attach to a URL/cloud backend where
``HERMES_DESKTOP`` is unset; without it the backend falls back to its own client detection.
``launch_id`` is an opaque per-launch token the backend latches on (never recorded), so a
reconnect re-sending the same launch counts once while a new launch counts again.
SharedMetricsStartupLatencyParams.title: SharedMetricsStartupLatencyParams

SkillsManageParams.description:
``query`` is the search text / hub identifier / browse page (digits); ``page`` / ``page_size``
apply to ``browse``.
SkillsManageParams.title: SkillsManageParams

SkillsManageResult.description:
Shape follows the action: ``list`` → ``skills`` (category → names); ``search`` → ``results``;
``install`` → ``installed`` + ``name``; ``browse`` → ``items`` + paging; ``inspect`` → ``info``.
SkillsManageResult.title: SkillsManageResult

SkillsReloadParams.description:
``session_id`` binds the rescan to that session's profile and workspace (project skills);
``profile`` scopes a session-less rescan.
SkillsReloadParams.title: SkillsReloadParams

SkinPayload.description:
``tui_runtime/change_watcher.py::resolve_skin`` — the resolved active skin (``HermesSkin``).
``{}`` when the skin engine failed to load. Colour maps are token → colour string.
SkinPayload.title: SkinPayload

SlashExecResult.description:
Plain worker/plugin text in ``output`` (+ ``warning``), or — when the command was rerouted to
``command.dispatch`` — that method's directive fields with ``type`` set.
SlashExecResult.title: SlashExecResult

SpawnTreeEntry.description: Index row (``server._append_spawn_tree_index``) or a legacy file scan.
SpawnTreeEntry.title: SpawnTreeEntry

SpawnTreeLoadResult.description: The snapshot file as written by ``spawn_tree.save`` (open: the file is the contract).
SpawnTreeLoadResult.title: SpawnTreeLoadResult

StatusUpdatePayload.description: ``server._status_update`` and the direct emitters (goal / loop / heartbeat / process).
StatusUpdatePayload.title: StatusUpdatePayload

StreamDeltaPayload.description:
``prompt_turn._invoke_agent._stream`` (message.delta: ``text`` + optional ``rendered``),
``agent_callbacks._agent_cbs`` (reasoning.delta / thinking.delta), ``tool_progress._progress_reasoning``
(reasoning.available). ``verbose`` rides only when the session's verbose reasoning mode is on.
StreamDeltaPayload.title: StreamDeltaPayload

SubagentEventPayload.description:
``tool_progress._progress_subagent`` — every ``subagent.*`` frame; identity fields are optional
because older emitters omit them and the TUI spawn tree falls back to flat rendering.
SubagentEventPayload.title: SubagentEventPayload

SubagentListResult.description: ``delegations``: recently failed async delegation tasks for the session (durable store), newest first.
SubagentListResult.title: SubagentListResult

SubagentSnapshot.description: ``methods_subagents._SUBAGENT_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS`` projection of one live child record.
SubagentSnapshot.title: SubagentSnapshot

SubagentStatus.description:
Lifecycle of one delegated child (``tools/delegate_tool_child_run.py``); ``failed`` /
``error`` / ``timeout`` / ``interrupted`` / ``completed`` are terminal.
SubagentStatus.title: SubagentStatus

SubagentSteerResult.description: ``queued`` is not ``delivered``: a child past its final tool batch surfaces ``missed_steer``.
SubagentSteerResult.title: SubagentSteerResult

SubagentTailResult.description: ``available`` is false while the child has no live transcript yet (or it was cleaned up).
SubagentTailResult.title: SubagentTailResult

SubscriptionChangeParams.description: Either a target tier (downgrade / same-price change) or ``cancel`` (period-end cancellation).
SubscriptionChangeParams.title: SubscriptionChangeParams

SubscriptionPreviewResult.description: ``_serialize_subscription_preview`` on success; ``effect`` drives the confirm copy.
SubscriptionPreviewResult.title: SubscriptionPreviewResult

SubscriptionStateResult.description: ``_serialize_subscription_state``; the view's fallback emits only ``ok / logged_in / error``.
SubscriptionStateResult.title: SubscriptionStateResult

SubscriptionUpgradeResult.description:
The money route: ``status`` separates a completed upgrade from an SCA / decline that must
finish in the portal at ``recovery_url``; ``idempotency_key`` is echoed (also on error) so a
retry reuses it.
SubscriptionUpgradeResult.title: SubscriptionUpgradeResult

SudoRequestParams.description: Original command, redacted server-side before any password-injection rewrite.
SudoRequestParams.title: SudoRequestParams

TaskIdResult.description:
The side agent runs detached; its answer lands on the parent session as an event carrying
this ``task_id``.
TaskIdResult.title: TaskIdResult

ToolCompletePayload.description: ``tool_progress._on_tool_complete``; ``todos``/``revision`` merged in for the todo tools.
ToolCompletePayload.title: ToolCompletePayload

ToolLabel.description:
``tools.tool_labels.ToolLabel`` — what one call executed through the tool_search bridge is,
in words. Clients render ``text`` (or ``app``/``action`` in their own columns) and never parse
the tool name themselves.
ToolLabel.title: ToolLabel

ToolLabelKind.description: Which surface one inner call of a bridged ``tool_call`` runs on.
ToolLabelKind.title: ToolLabelKind

ToolStartPayload.description:
``tool_progress._on_tool_start`` (+ ``agent_callbacks._mirror_subagent_to_child`` rows with
``preview`` and empty ``args``). ``todos``/``revision`` are NOT set by the emitter; kept optional
because tool.start rows may pass through connector redaction unchanged.
ToolStartPayload.title: ToolStartPayload

ToolsConfigureParams.description:
``names`` are toolset keys or ``server:tool`` MCP targets; with ``session_id`` the live session's
profile is authoritative and its agent is rebuilt.
ToolsConfigureParams.title: ToolsConfigureParams

ToolsetRow.description:
One row of ``methods_tools._toolset_rows``; ``tools`` only when the caller asked for them
(``tools.list``).
ToolsetRow.title: ToolsetRow

TranscriptMessage.description:
One transcript row as the gateway PROJECTS it for renderers (``session_history._project_history``):
``text``, display-only ``timestamp`` / ``display_kind`` / ``display_metadata``, the durable ``row_id``
rewind targets, and for tool rows raw ``content``, ``tool_call_id``, ``name``, ``context`` and ``args``.
Assistant detail sidecars (``reasoning``, …) ride as extra keys.
TranscriptMessage.title: TranscriptMessage

UsageBar.description: ``_serialize_usage_bar``: one bar, magnitudes pre-formatted; ``pct_used`` only for ``plan``.
UsageBar.title: UsageBar

UsageModel.description:
``_serialize_usage_model`` — also embedded as ``usage`` in the billing / subscription states,
where the fail-open form is a bare ``{available: false}`` (no ``ok``).
UsageModel.title: UsageModel

ValueResult.description:
The answer to any one-string prompt (sudo, secret, vault prompts, desktop bridges):
``''`` means skipped / declined.
ValueResult.title: ValueResult

VaultAddParams.description: ``secret`` goes straight into the encrypted store; the result carries only the new id.
VaultAddParams.title: VaultAddParams

VaultUnlockParams.description: The master password is consumed by the manager CLI and never stored or logged.
VaultUnlockParams.title: VaultUnlockParams

VerificationStatusInfo.description:
``verification_status()``: ``disabled`` / ``not_applicable`` / ``unverified`` / ``stale`` or the
latest event's own status; ``root`` and friends only once a workspace was identified.
VerificationStatusInfo.title: VerificationStatusInfo

VoicePartialPayload.description: ``methods_voice`` voice.record ``on_partial`` — live STT text so far (``stt.streaming``).
VoicePartialPayload.title: VoicePartialPayload

VoiceStatusPayload.description: ``methods_voice._vr_on_status``; states come from the recorder (idle / listening / transcribing …).
VoiceStatusPayload.title: VoiceStatusPayload

VoiceToggleResult.description:
``methods_voice.py::_voice_status_payload`` (+ the requirements probe on ``status``, the spoken
stop hint on ``on``).
VoiceToggleResult.title: VoiceToggleResult

WakeFeedParams.description: ``pcm`` (or the ``pcm_b64`` alias): base64 int16 mono little-endian, 16 kHz only.
WakeFeedParams.title: WakeFeedParams

WakeInputDevice.description: ``tools/wake_word.py::_describe_input_device`` — PortAudio diagnostics for the configured mic.
WakeInputDevice.title: WakeInputDevice

WakeStartParams.description:
``surface`` names the caller ("tui" | "gui"); ``persist`` is the explicit gesture that also
flips ``wake_word.enabled`` on; ``client_capture`` asks for PCM streamed via wake.feed.
WakeStartParams.title: WakeStartParams

WakeStartResult.description:
``started: false`` carries ``reason`` (unavailable / disabled / disabled_for_surface / owned);
``sample_rate`` / ``frame_length`` describe the PCM frames the armed detector expects.
WakeStartResult.title: WakeStartResult

WakeStatusResult.description:
``enabled`` is config truth; ``listening`` is this caller's armed detector; ``audio_silent``
means armed but deaf (see ``hint``).
WakeStatusResult.title: WakeStatusResult

_SessionScoped.description:
Handlers that look a live session up with ``_sessions.get(params.get("session_id"))``: an
absent / unknown id falls back to the launch profile's config, so it is never required.
_SessionScoped.title: _SessionScoped
